text: Had the rueben sandwich and California omelet. Both delicious and well made, the hash browns were crispy and the raisin bread was delicious. Super friendly staff as well.
Small little place with amazing authentic food! Pork tacos, steak tacos and quesadillas are so delicious. Prices are ridiculously reasonable.
This is my favorite restaurant period. Great food & excellent service. I'm always excited about going to Brigtsen's and even happier after desert.
First the food is amazing and the servers are so attentive (and ours -Key- made the evening!) Don't leave without getting the Cinnamon Toast Bread-pudding with Fireball sauce!

We went to Eegee's today after a two month absence due to the pandemic. On our last visit in May, my garden salad contained olives even though I asked for none and my sons veggie sandwich which he likes with only lettuce, cheese, house dressing and tomato was made without cheese (we noticed both when we arrived home.) When I called the manager was nice about it and told us next time we came in that he would replace the food items at no cost. 

Today we decided that we were going to try Eegee's again. Upon ordering I explained the situation to the cashier and he sought out assistance from the manager. She checked the office for the information but did let me know that next time, if a food item is made wrong, you only have 7 days to come in for a replacement. This seemed reasonable and I wasn't upset that this is Eegee's policy, I just didn't recall the manager telling me that in May. 

We ordered our food to go while the lobby filled up. While ordering, the garden salad is no longer available ($4.99) and in its place are now all meat options unless you would like a side salad. The salads are priced at $6.99 which is disappointing in that there are no longer any regular size vegetarian salad options and now they are $2 more. 

And... when we arrived home and unwrapped the subs, the 5 inch veggie was still made incorrectly.   :(

Even with a skeleton crew these guys were awesome! Their customer service is always top notch and that is one of the many reasons I continue to order from here and the the pizza gets better every time!!!! Thank you to John and his crew for the wonderful work!

I come to this store because its 2 miles from work. They are always understaffed, their specials change so often the website specials seldom match the restaurants. About a month ago, was charged 3 different prices for the same special. No leadership in this store.

Not sure how this place has good reviews. They serve the take out food in styrofoam with no foil under. The food melted the styrofoam which made it taste terrible. On top of that there was no flavor to begin with and when I brought it back the owner let me know she cannot refund the $26 I paid for two meals. She only offered to remake one meal and put foil in the box after we asked for foil so it doesn't melt the styrofoam again. Will definitely not be back and be sure to let everyone know to avoid this place. I should have gone to Thai Chili Pepper, which I was originally going to do. Such a mistake every trying this place, stay away! You'll be glad you did :)

What a hidden gem!!!!!  Recommended by a local while we're out walking.   I am so glad we checked it out!   We had the blackened shrimp bowl,  the pulled pork bowl and clam chowder.  The soup was duhhhhlicious!!!!  The bowls were super tasty with so much flavor and a pinch of heat. We can't wait to go back for fish dinners!!! This place is highly recommended.  Go early or make a reservation!

New experience for me. A cute little restaurant located in a renovated barn, check out the cute gift shop located in the loft! The oatmeal creme brule was delicious served with Caramelized brown sugar, pastry creme and fresh berries.

Had a lovely dinner the other night. It's a steak house after all. ;-) so we had prime rib. 

It was delicious. We both wanted end cuts and were there early enough to get them. "Real" end cuts, not a rib that's been put on the grill. Shutter. 

Mine was a beautiful, bright medium-rare; my dinner partner asked for medium-well (I know!) and said it was perfect. We had a Caesar and house salad, and baked potatoes (with everything on the side lol), and indulged in a huge scoop of vanilla bean ice cream to finish our meal. 

Service was spot on. Food, delicious. Beef, so satisfying. We left feeling very happy and full and will definitely be back. 

Had a nice wine, too

No pics, sorry. It was a deliberately disconnected meal.
Not sure what happen but Bertucci's has gone downhill in a big way. The last 3 times I have gone I have been very disappointed not sure why I keep coming back. Probably will not be back now!!!
Best sushi in Santa Barbara. Nuff said. But I will add that the chef and his crew are all amazing and really remind you of why eating sushi at the counter is how it's meant to be.

I have patronized at first watch in VA MD, this was the most rude franchise.  I use the yelp waitlist and it was 14 minute. But when I checked in it becomes 45 minute.   Her excuse was there is a group of 15 who came in after everyone's reservation.  I would advise people never to go there.

Fabulous food, amazing drinks and friendly staff.  A very pleasant dinning dining experience for families, couples or when you are dining alone. 
Call ahead to reserve a table.

Hands down my favorite Cuban sandwich of all time (and I've tried them in southern Florida and Cuba).

I order The Obama with double honey & the works 

I think about this place at least once every three days and I would give it 6 stars if I could.

the freshest smoothie/bowl joint in all of california, now doubt!

I continuously come back here to try out all of the drinks that they have here. I'm very happy with how delicious everything is here!

I love that I had to introduce my craft beer loving boyfriend to this brewery. He thought he knew all the spots around here but not so much!! I got some major brownie points with this one because it just has an awesome vibe, great beer selection that has something for everyone and it always changing plus super chill staff. And their logo is a unicorn... how could you go wrong?

They are pup friendly with two picnic tables outside alongside the building with umbrellas where my girls like to act like they are humans and sit next to us while trying to get into the beer while we are not looking. 

I was very excited to see today that they have opened their doors for To-Go orders during this COVID-19 quarantine so be sure to continue to support local!

Absolutely delish! My boyfriend and I mad reservations for brunch before the eagles vs ravens game, and I am sad we couldn't go back for dinner. Everything was great, the staff was lovely and so personable. I appreciate that  they are taking COVID procedures so seriously, We felt safe the whole time. The food was beyond anything I could imagine, DO GET the lemon poppy seed pancakes and chicken and waffles you will not regret it. Cannot wait to visit again, while in Philly.
Solid Thai restaurant. My favorite panang curry in Tampa; I love the vegetable mix included in the dish.
Love their chicken with the Alabama white sauce and those decadent little rolls!  I've used them for catering many times and they've been great!

First night in NoLA found ourselves walking around the French Quarter as many tourists may. And were pulled into the line of Oceana Grill. The area was bright and buzzing. The backyard patio seating was a perfect dimly lit area. We ordered their specialty seafood pasta -which my table loved. What got me hooked was their crawfish etouffe and jambalaya. As side dishes they were stand out. The oysters I could have done without. Definitely meaty if that's your preference. We had great service by Ashleigh and a great into to dining out here.

My second time to the Farmacy, and I enjoyed the heck out of both visits.  Our foursome literally applauded the chefs when we we're finished.  We sent 4 completely clean plates back with our server.  First, the coffee is fantastic- so good that I distinctly remembered it from visit one.   I had the breakfast Burger which was cooked perfectly and very flavorful.  My friends had chicken and biscuits that they loved.  Father in law from Brooklyn had Potato Latkes, and he pronounced them 95% Brooklyn worthy.  Nothing gets 100%.  The server, manager, and chefs are all so nice it's like eating at home- actually the Farmacy  treats us better.  Love this place so much,  but I live in Rhode Island.  Next time in NJ I'm here

Definitely a tourist trap, but we were hungry for lunch and they didn't have a wait.  It's a huge restaurant and loud with country music/music videos blasting.  Food was alright, you're paying $17 for a plain burger and fries, nothing to highlight!  There are so many places on Broadway to eat...skip this one.
I would for sure go again. Very relaxed and spaced out and cozy environment. Help is very attentive  something you must have to enjoy and get full the experience of  a place.

Good beagles... Not the best. Hard on heavy. Some people like that I guess. When you toast them they lighten up a little when you butter them. Well, no... they don't. LOL! But, they still taste good. Wish they would last a little longer. After 3 to 4 days mold sets in and you have to throw them away. So, if you don't eat them right away then just get a couple. I know my Lenders last weeks before they even start to taste different due to the "aging" process. HAHA! Have a good one and good luck.
What an adorable local coffee shop! Great coffee, atmosphere, and eclectic menu. Women owned business with friendly staff. I'll be back!
Expensive, but worth it. Classy dinner. Busy. Had to wait even with reservations which isn't the place's fault. Will edit more later

Had an amazing meal here! We ended up sitting at the bar bc the bartender was so amazing. The pineapple daiquiri he made us was delicious! We ordered the crab cake and crab casserole for apps! The casserole came with toasted bread. For entrees we had the lamb burger and scallops n grits (a daily special). Dessert was bread pudding (AMAZING) and strawberry cobbler! Both were so flavorful and good! I love Station 6 and can't wait to return.

The rooftop bar was cool. 

We had drinks and nachos. Never in my life have I had nachos with no flavor. Between the cheese, beans, corn, tomatoes, etc...none of it had any flavor. It was the strangest thing. Neither of us could really taste anything. Worst $16 of nachos and that's saying a lot as I'm a frequent nacho order-er at football games.

Stick to the drinks.

Three years ago, i wrote a review on this Cheddar's, so it's time for an update. When we entered, we were absolutely the first patrons in the door. Our super server, Kylie, took care of us the entire meal.

Like last time, I ordered the Monte Cristo with the powdered sugar and, for dipping, raspberry preserves. It was as good today as it was in 2016. My wife's baby back ribs looked as good today as they had all the other times.

Incredibly, not much has changed in three years. The food wasn't fancy schmancy, but it tasted good, the portions were large and the prices  were reasonable. Oh, we got über good service from super server Kylie, but I'm not changing Cheddar's four star rating.
Super quick, convenient, tasty food, and delivery is always way earlier than predicted. This is becoming my go-to local spot for delivery & takeout.

Wonderful experience!!! The food was mediocre but the service made up for that!-the cute blonde who waited on us went over and above the call of duty for our table. I could tell see was tired but that didn't prevent her from taking care all our needs efficiently and with a smile. She was a gem! Will come again because of her and the atmosphere.

Jus finished eating here, and it's outstanding! From the moment I walked in the friendly staff welcomed me and took my order. The manager Josh also greeted me and was super friendly. I ordered Cali Grilled Chicken Club and it was delicious. Got a side of steamed broccoli, also delicious. I'll be a regular here whenever I'm in the area! Highly recommend!

*UPDATED*

Visiting from Cali and I can never give up on my place. I love the owner... as always he greets you with a smile and ready to help you customize any platter you may fancy. 

I also love the new look, more spacious and you would think that because it is a seafood place you would smell a strong fishy smell, NOT AT ALL! The place is always clean and I can truly appreciate that...

Nevertheless, I got a wonderful platter as always and devoured it with my loves.

I will return every chance I get lol
Wanted to give a shout out to Kelly our waitress / bartender. We had lunch there and she was the perfect hostess .

Umm can we take a minute to discuss the best tacos I've had in months? We ordered the lamb tacos and the fish tacos both were DIVINE. At first I was a bit worried when one entree only consisted of two tacos but they were huge and filled with the meat and fish and I just couldn't contain my happiness. I also ordered the churros for our table to share, and they did not disappoint. Our server was super helpful and even gathered recommendations from the rest of the staff to help us find more spots to continue our girls night out!

You've truely never had a burger until you've gotten a burger from The Burger's Priest! I had the heavy which was the perfect combination of lettuce a special sauce meat patty pickle breaded Jalapeño. It was truely an amazing burger, I wanted to take a bite close my eyes and savour every taste! Amazing doesn't come close to describing it! My boyfriend had the Vatican City, which is a MONSTER of a burger!  The buns are grilled cheese sandwiches and in between you have the juiciest patty that truly tasted fresh! Ordering from skip is always hit or miss, how long is this going to take to get to me and how soggy is the bun going to be ? Well these burgers held up to the challenge! This is a bucket list burger place! Now If only I could take it back to my home town with me!

Visited this place mid March around 1pm for a late lunch. Fun hip interior, I mean, just look at their menu, and after you've done giggling, you could also leave your marks with markers on the walls, ceiling and etc. 

Service: It took a little bit for host to seat us but our server was prompt and knowledgeable. 

Quesadilla: plenty cheesy, real good scramble egg the avocado ranch drizzle on top was interesting... wish it was on the side with more fresh pico.
And my husband enjoyed his burrito and agreed that the scramble egg was fluffy and a delight. 

Overall, we'd come back to try their omelets. It also looks like they have a separate room to host small party.

Holy Hell Hard Rock! So this used to be a stable favorite. Food was always good.... not any more. So bad enough they change the great ranch dressing, the have now changed the Nachos!  Sweet tasting yuck!!!   Cobb Salad without bacon???   It's like hired a bad chef or food designer and let them change everything!   Why do successful restaurants do this and totally destroy their customer base.

AHH this place is so cute. I have been here so many time through the years and its always been amazing. We had Will as our waiter and he was a hoot! He answered all of our questions and knew how to pronounce all the drinks we couldn't say ha! We came for drinks and dessert and got the lovers plate and martinis. 4 of us couldn't even finish the whole plate! We are looking forward to coming here for dinner soon!

You can make reservations online (Which I recommend) to avoid long waits since this place can get pretty busy! Love the vibes love the martinis!
What a way to top off great ski / board days, here. Everything we order here makes me feel nostalgia. Like home. (a Taiwanese American).

This week we ate the weekly lunch, and the coconut chicken was perfection! We noticed they were advertising the Sunday breakfast Buffett. It's BACK and WOW! There is a cold cheese and salad selection, omelet and waffle station, and traditional breakfast items like grits, eggs, casseroles... I mean SO many amazing items. The staff is truly a delight to interact with! New ownership has really turned this place around, and we look forward to becoming regulars again!

One of my favorite spots in Indy! Always such a treat to visit here. Never a bad meal or experience. Hope was a kick ass server and it was a fantastic surprise to see Maya there! She made the night wonderful! I can't wait to go back for new dishes to try!

I have nothing but amazing things to say about Good Dog! First, the service is amazing and the servers are super sweet. I always feel at home when I go there. I got the Good Dog Burger and it was out of this world. SO YUMMY!!! I also got fries (which were also amazing) and a few drinks. I am definitely returning!

Checked in on yelp which helped determine what time we needed to get to the restaurant. Nice ambiance. Service was quick for a party of 7. The food is good as well as the drinks. One of the cups was dirty but that was quickly rectified

4 1/2 star average? Maybe it's because my expectations were just so high about NOLA cuisine, that I am rating this place so low.  Really would rate a 2 1/2 if I could but its Yelp.  Anywho, IDK if the waitress was new but she knew  zilch about their beer selection other than, her last customer really liked one of them.  Next, I ordered some standard LO fare, red beans and rice, and gumbo.  Gumbo was barely warm and not that good.  The red beans and rice was okay, but I had to add hot sauce.  Next the entrees.  I got a shrimp remoulade on ciabatta and my wife had a fried oyster salad.  My sandwich was just okay.  Really the temperature is what threw me off.  Was it supposed to be a cold sandwich? Because the shrimp were closer to room temp than hot or cold.  My wife's salad was a total bomb.  The blue cheese was completely overpowering, way too much was added and though there was an extremely generous portion of oysters, they were flavorless.  So disappointing.  Glad we went at happy hour when the apps and booze were discounted.  Will not be coming back.

I appreciate that this establishment was able to deliver to our location but what I paid was absolutely not worth it. The pictures on yelp from other customers looked amazing!!! I ordered the Mexican Paella and ewww it was not good. When I think of paella, I think of beautiful rice on the bottom with seafood on top. I expected something authentic like big shrimp with the tail in tact, but the shrimp were small and underwhelming, lobster was soggy, had no bounce and I couldn't distinguish if it was lobster. Chicken was dry, cuts of pork were inconsistent. This is some you eat and scared your going to regret it later. 
I got my wife what was supposed to be beef taco salad but what showed up was chicken. That was very underwhelming as well. 
Mini chimys were bad too. You could tell they did not fry them individually because looks like they just took 6 of them out of the tray and dropped them all together into the deep fryer. There were some chimys that were soggy and white and weren't golden brown. Overall I probably won't be eating here again. When you pay this much for food you expect quality food and Guadalajara Original Grill did not deliver.

We dined here while staying in the Angad Arts Hotel. The ambiance is relaxed, and the staff are welcoming. We did not have a reservation, but they were able to fit us in because it was early. (Make a reservation.) I had the scallops, and they were perfect. We also had breakfast in our room served by this restaurant. The potatoes are unlike any other, and the housemade granola is delicious! We plan on eating here many more times. This restaurant is a hidden gem!
I love the chicken shrimp and steak fajitas they are very good service is good nice friendly people take your order and bring your food right out

We have dined here several times and have always found the service to be great. The atmosphere is wonderful- cozy, romantic, and laid- back. They also have a few tables set up outside for those who prefer outdoor dining at this time. Make sure to have a reservation beforehand because this place is always packed! We love their pizza (huge fans of wood- fires pizza) and can never resist ordering the calamari- perfectly crisp and comes with three unique and delicious sauces ( garlic aioli, spicy mayo, and tomato basil). Our favorite pizza has been the Carne- house- made sausage, smoked bacon, pepperoni, and sweet onions. I'm typically not a fan of meat on my pizza, but this has so much flavor and is not greasy like you would expect. 
This is a great fixture to the Harahan area.

The place was just average and I was not a fan of the quantity of food for the price. The passion fruit juice was great. The portions are very small and everything I ate from the falafel, stuffed spinach leaves, hummus, salad were just okay. The pita bread was fresh and moist.

We eat here every single week! We used to get pizza from a shop down the road... NYNY has such better flavor & taste!! Plus, it's cheaper than the other. 
The food is always consistently great! Friendly employees. It can get very busy, so ensure plenty of time.
Great menu choices and many options for vegetarians. The salad selections are especially creative and unique. Friendly staff, too!
Service was extremely slow.  We waited 40 min for apps to come out then another 30+ min for main course.  Pad Thai was very fishy.
I had the grilled salmon for lunch with broccoli. I was surprised to see how small my salmon was. The dish cost $17.00. I was angry. I will not be eating that again.

I've been to Dandelion three times now! I love this spot. Great location and probably has the best pods in the city. The food is very delicious and the cocktails are on point. We got the jungle lion cocktail in a pitcher, which is a tequila drink! Not too sweet and super good!

First thing I noticed after I ordered is how the tables are not wiped off at all.  Nasty.  Went outside to get the wipes and clean my own table and seat.  The girl taking order had attitude.  Glad the mask covered what was surly an unhappy face. The food.  Catfish was pretty good.   I would get that again.  Chicken was mediocre at best.  Greens were mush straight outa can.  Nasty and shameful.   Too easy to make fresh greens nowadays.   They come clean and precut in bag.  So that's totally lazy.  And gross.  And more expensive using canned!!!  Frozen fries.   Coleslaw out of a waxed box.  With all that I would not go back.  Lunch for 2 $30.   Nawwww.   Not again.

I couldn't disagree more with "Michael D". We are a white family who has never had any less than a positive experience; and we have never been treated with any prejudice on the owners part. Additionally his accusation against them for having a "racist" sign in the window is false...I just saw their Black Lives Matter sign today. But, most importantly, we enjoy our dinner treat every time we order!

This was our first meal on a trip to New Orleans and it did not disappoint! The service was excellent, cute intimate interior. We shared a few different tapas and split an entree and dessert--try as many dishes as you can!
Love coming here when I'm in town! It's a great spot to grab a beer and good pub food right in Downtown Tucson. I've been here for brunch as well and they have great French toast creations.

We just left the restaurant after waiting an hour for a simple pizza which never arrived. Experience started out OK as we were promptly seated, told the specials and ordered. The order was very easy: a salad and a pizza. Salad arrived promptly but the pizza never came. We asked our waitress several times and she did check on it and said it would be coming shortly. Shortly never happened. At one point the busboy even asked us what happened to our pizza. After seeing that all the tables that sat down after us were already eating, we gave up. The waitress apologized again (gave us our bill for the salad which we paid) and we left. 

Very disappointing experience. I really don't like writing negative reviews but an hour to get a pizza is beyond comprehension. We have eaten here before and the food has been good but with numerous choices for similar food, I would stick with Liberty Hall in Lambertville or Delorenzo's in Yardley.

Great juicy burgers, mozz sticks, french fries, etc. Have not tried any of the drinks. Whenever I am in the neighborhood, I go to this spot! Also have a really good kids menu, the only hangup is it is cash only (there is an ATM inside)

I'm just floored by the extremely fair and even generous pricing of such a diverse and opportunistic menu. A MUST try for anybody that enjoys or would like to expand their horizons on Indian cuisine in Philly
Awesome made to order guacamole. Great juices. Healthy, tasty and tons of choices. Delivery is quick.

Came in on a busy night Saturday night. We had no reservations so we sat inside which was fine. We self served and ordered a small pizza and Classico wine which both were outstanding.  As we were about to leave we were told that we owed $24 for a cover charge for a musician who was sitting outside and we could no hear or see. 

No table service. Can not hear the music over screaming babies and a few drunk loud idiots and we get billed $24.00. 

Why should we ever return when they try and screw you over for this?   This is a sad business plan which will turn off many future customers. 

This ruined a good day of visiting wineries in South Jersey.

Yats is a small, casual restaurant with a relaxed feeling. The staff is very pleasant. I ordered red beans with sausage over rice. It was tasty, but there was almost no sausage in it. I had a dinner of beans and rice.

Ordered carry out last night and it was amazing. I got the Impossible Meatball Pizza.  I was the best vegan pizza I've had. Can't wait to get it again. Husband had the Fried Green Tomatoes he really liked them. They made carry out so easy by having a walk up window outside. Noble Crust is on the top of my restaurant list.  Thanks for having Vegan options.

Just not a feasible lunch option. They're always late. Waiting for my takeout order to come up burns up the entire lunch time and that is with calling ahead. They don't update you on what's happening. Just completely unacceptable.

I've never visited Peddler's Village when they didn't have some kind of event going on but every festival I've ever attended has always been a good time. The peach festival is hands down my absolute favorite. So many cute shops to check out. Great drinks and treats to taste. Overall cute atmosphere.

We stopped at the Shop Kitchen before a hike and it did not disappoint! The banana toast was delicious; the almond butter was very coarse which lead to a nice crunch on top of the toast. This toast didn't have too many ingredients but it was done very well. We sat outside, nice tables and good service!
Great wings!  Couldn't stop eating them. Good size  wings!  And you get plenty of ranch and celery to go along with them!  Great place!

Salty Crab was able to accommodate our large party on a very rainy evening.  Hostess was very bubbly.  Food was good, recommend trying a boil, something very interesting about your dinner arriving in a tied up plastic bag!!  Live music was a little loud for the kids but we definitely enjoyed the experience.

My husband and I came here for our wedding anniversary. We spent our honeymoon in Japan and were looking for authentic Japanese, specifically Yakiniku. We made reservations for 7pm. Although we had to wait a little for our table to be ready (about 15 minutes) the staff were very courteous and apologetic. Jesse, our waiter, was knowledgeable and attentive. We ordered 4 meats a la carte, 2 large rice sides, and the matcha tiramisu for dessert. We could have probably gotten away with ordering 1 order of rice, but it was nice to have leftovers. Everything was delicious and the atmosphere enjoyable. The matcha tiramisu was just ok. Our favorite items were the hanger steak, toro beef, and garlic fried rice. We will be back!

This is my favorite pizza place in the Nashville area.  When you walk in it's a little underwhelming - paper plates, plastic knives & forks, paper towels.  But the draft beer choices are a perfect blend of superb local brews, and the pizza - Mama Mia.  Delicious!  It's like the best tasting pizza you ever had in your hometown growing up.  Worth the drive out to Goodlettsville for the flavors.

Pinefish's happy hour is great! You get some awesome deals for food and drinks. You also have buck a shuck oysters, which are great. The best thing is that their happy hour still happens on weekends! 

We ordered a variety of small plates. My favorites were the truffle mashed potatoes, brussel sprouts, and calamari. We also had their chocolate cake for dessert, which was great!
Good food and probably the best service I have had at a restaurant in a long time. The wait staff was attentive and knowledgeable on the menu.
I was served cold Mac n cheese and they were out of chicken wings at noon on Saturday. Probably won't try again. It's a shame Moe's Original bbq downtown closed...

Met several friends for dinner Friday night.  Make reservations because this place is very popular.  Food is delish.  From ceviche to grilled steak skewers...everything was great!  The shrimp arepas was seasoned to perfection.  Full cocktail menu, but I recommend the caipirinha light ice and any flavor mojito.  Price ranges are from $9-$18.  Easy to park on the street.  Friendly staff but reservations are a MUST.  If you can't get a table the bar area is great too.

Amazing tacos at a fantastic price for a restaurant on Mass Ave. The tacos are great portions and the flavors are delicious! My favorite tacos that I have tried here are the Baja Shrimp, Short Rib, & the Al Pastor. However, I have never had a bad or even mediocre taco here. I really like the Mezcal marg & would recommend the Mezcal Margarita for anyone who likes Mezcal or a strong drink.

The service has been really great as well, with all employees wearing masks and seating being appropriately socially distanced.

Update: We dined here again when my husband thought it was a new place in town, when we pulled up he was surprised that he hadn't remembered, but we were both excited because we enjoyed it so much the first time (see below). I ordered the shrimp salad this time, and he ordered three tacos with a side of rice. The wings were (still) delicious. I can't say this enough - THE SHRIMP SALAD WAS THE BEST SALAD I HAVE EVER HAD. My spouse didn't love his entree; he thought it lacked flavor. In any case, we will be back. I've attached pictures this time. 

------
Original post:
We had a really great experience at Mekenita Cantina. The servers were wonderful. There is a bit of a wait on a weekend night, so make sure that you make a reservation if you are planning to dine here. Fortunately there's a little wine room next door so we had a beer while we waited. When we were seated we were informed that the restaurant has a relationship with the wine bar and that patrons are permitted to bring drinks from the wine bar into the restaurant. 

The food was excellent. We ordered guacamole and chips, and the crispy wings as an appetizer. Both were incredible. I had the shrimp burrito, which we could substitute the fried for the grilled shrimp. It was delicious. I also ordered a classic margarita which was not on the drink menu but was really well done and had a beautiful presentation (sorry I didn't take pictures).

I give this place four stars because I wish they had more options and a better v

This is a great go-to for all of your sushi and Thai needs!!   It's a solid restaurant, with better than average service, great food, a clean and elegant atmosphere.  The prices are average and fair.  You won't be disappointed.

A great meal, experience.
First time trying out a Chicago dog. Too many topping for me honestly I guess I'm just a plain hot dog type of guy lol.

My boyfriend and I stayed at DoubleTree during our time here and saw that Mother's was closeby. The restaurant is well known from the Food Network so we decided to check it out. Came around 5pm and was greeted by a waitress who told us to grab a menu and go order in line.
I ordered a Oyster Po Boy and my boyfriend ordered the sausage po boy and fries. The oyster po boy wasn't bad. However, the French bread was dry and we got tired of chewing after a few bites. The fries were a let down as well. The food was cold, wasn't even close to being lukewarm. We had higher expectations. Locals say that breakfast is better but I don't think we'll be coming back. Place was overhyped.

Awesome brewery. Great list of beers to pick from. Fast & friendly service. Very clean.  Big space to sit inside or outside.  Amazing wings & pulled pork kettle chips were delicious! Will definitely be back here again

Soo 3* 
Mango smoothie excellent!
The biscuits and gravy were good but they put gravy on the biscuits so when I got to actually eat it, it was so soggy and fell apart couldn't eat much of it ( plus the gravy was mostly sausage bits ... were is my gravy?
The roobios tea they have great blend! 

Chicken salad.... what the heck?!
ALL CRLERY AND LEEKS! And almonds barely any chicken! So terrible waste of money
Had the Greek burger with feta on a salad.  Very juicy.   Perfectly cooked.   Fresh greens.   They delivery over to the brewery.   Good combo.   Beer n burger.   I'll be back

Pretty decent sushi. I had two specialty rolls and a clear soup. The fish was fresh and pretty tasty. The rice was a little bit on the bland side, but I'm not complaining. The clear soup, however was way too salty. It tasted like I was drinking hot soy sauce, which was disappointing. However, all that being said, it's a very decent sushi spot; and they're open late which is another plus! Overall pretty good. *Thumbs up*

Great fried chicken and sides! Everything was tasty. Including the chess pie. 
The service isn't fast, but the food is worth the wait!
The food was amazing and our service was outstanding our server Ruben was very attentive, and fast paced we will definitely will be coming back and requesting him every time. Awesome job!

First Time in Nashville.  Recommended by a friend.  Amazing!  

Memphis taco was superb, slight kick from the Jalapeño coleslaw made it bounce just right. 

Brisket taco, sooo soft!!  Sooo juicy!!!  And heavy to boot!

Carnita taco, pork is flawless!  Slight cilantro kicks it up a notch! 

All these different flavors demands that you polish off your plate!  And guess what!  That's what I did!

If you want the best hot dog in town 
Head over to my friends at Sinbads Hot Dog!!!!!!!!
They are the greatest !!
They are a local business taking care of the community during these trying times . 
Keeping there doors open with curb side service . 
So go ahead and stop by and try a dog you won't  regret it . 
Yummmmmmm remember best dog in town and you owe to yourself!!!!!!
Loved this place!!!! We got to sit outside and you feel like you are in Italy! Food was really good, and we are Mexican food snobs!!! We will definitely come back next time we are in town.

First of all, I love this building - the windows, the color scheme inside and out, and the trendy interior décor that makes me wish I could hire their design team for my house. 

I recently came here with a group of 10 ladies. We made reservations beforehand and when we got to the restaurant, they had a large high-top table ready for us. It was definitely a good fit for our group and there was enough space for all our drinks and food :)

We had a great dining experience. Our server was very nice and attentive - he gave us recommendations/suggestions on what drinks to order and he didn't seem dispirited when we said we wanted to order every appetizer item off the menu before we ordered our entrees. Haha, yes, we ordered a lot! My favorite apps were the: Truffle Fries, Main Lobster, and the Goat Cheese Sformato. For my entrée, I ordered the Orecchiette - sausage, squash, bitter greens, and chestnuts - but got to try a little bit of everyone else's entrées (the beauty of dining with a group of friends who love food) and seriously, all the entrées were sooo dang delicious! The most impressive and unique dish to me, is their Squid Ink Casareecce - key west shrimp, lobster brood, fresno chili, soppressata, and scallions. I was WOW'ed by the taste and I already look forward to ordering this for myself next time. 

Oh, also it is worth mentioning about their drinks. I ordered The Indigo - Stoli Blueberry, St. Germain, and Cucumber. I don't really care for drinks that have "Stoli" but
I live 5 minutes away , it took an hour and a half to get my delivery cold. And it made me and my 5 year old sick .

If i could give thos place zero stars i would horrible customer service. My friends and i would play d&d on wendsdays and we have ordered from this place a couple times. The first time we ordered the delivery driver couldnt find my house (i have no idea how gps goes right to my house fine for everyone else) and they never called we waited for like an hour hour and a half and they were like couldnt find your house. Like why would you not call me and tell me this?! They always forgot the sauces. It would take them like an hour- hour and a half, food was cold when it got here. One time they forgot our pizza and they said they were gonna send anouther one with a free dessert... never got it. I work in retail, im not mean when i call to complain, but the manager was always a dick. Will never go back save yourself the pain dont order from here.

This is the restaurant you want to go to for morning breakfasts, afternoon lunches and night-time dinners from a diner-like vibe with the open-seating spaciousness for family occasions. I went here for breakfast with the whole crew and found the service to be very attentive, but not overdone--and the food  feeling like a, "welcome home" get-more-than-you-expected delicious flare. Couldn't tell you the price because Boss took care of us that day, but word was that he made out pretty good not having to pay much at all. I'd say come here and figure it out for yourself, but I already did that for you, so get in!;) --pretty solid coffee too.

I'm keeping this at four stars, but I'm not sure why we get orange chicken when ordering sesame chicken. It's just orange chicken with the sesame seeds on top. So odd. We probably won't order this again. The crab rangoons remain delicious. They do deliver if you use the grubhub app.

The happy hour from 3-6 Monday -Friday is awesome. They have raw oysters that are creamy, briney, and delicious. Their po-boys are delish and very generous portion sizing. The staff at the bar are super friendly, funny and the correct level of attentive.

Selected Owyee for the first part of a birthday evening.  Reservation for 5 at 5:15 to take advantage of happy hour drinks.  Waiting as close to 6 as possible when happy hour ended, the server appeared at 6!  When we tried to order another round she said sorry it was 6:01!  She refused to honor our happy our price by one minute (I held up my phone for her to see the time)  even though she did not present her self a moment or two before so we could order. (we did see her several times before that but where not ready for the second round)  Upon ordering dinner we specifically said we had the second part of birthday night to get to and must be out NO LATER  than 6:40....Well the found did not arrive until 6:35 and she sold us on a 3 course complete with ice cream desert.  After having to request the ticket because we would miss our next event, the ticket arrived at 6:45 along with boxed ice ream and cobbler to take! She still had to collect our payment after that.  Dinner was a complete rush and didn't even get to eat what we paid for.  If it was not going to be able to be served in the alotted time, why didn't she explain this so we could order appropriately??  I complained to the general manager by email the next day.  He said she was trained to accept happy hour in the computer until 6:10 to avoid delays that sometimes happen.  Other than that???? no compensation or response back when I explained what happen to the rest of the dinner.
Used carry out. Long line. Very efficient. 8 minute wait. Got home, order was accurate and food was still very hot. Excellent Job

I came here with a group of 9 people on a weeknight during rush.  There are two floors and we surprisingly got seated right away,  on the second level next to a screened in porch. It was a beautiful night.  There may be gratuity of 20% for parties of 6 or more.  We told the waiter ahead of time that we would need separate checks,  and because of this,  no gratuity added.  There was a wide variety of beverages,  full bar. The menu was pretty expansive.  I had the southern fried chicken with cheesy potatoes and green beans.  Everything that came out looked delicious.  It was fun and tasty.

This is a cute local spot in Roxborough! There are a ton of pierogie options to try! And it's not just pierogie, there are salads, sandwiches, wraps  etc. I had Original PK stacker and it was delicious; the kielbasa was cooked well and the pierogie on top was a perfect touch! I also had a side of honey sriracha pierogi which were seriously amazing!!! Those are definitely a must try!! I wasn't a big fan of the apple, horseradish coleslaw that came with my sandwich-it was an odd mix of flavors. 

My fiancé tried the spicy chicken stacker. Unfortunately, the chicken was wayy over cooked which took away from the sandwich. I do think if the chicken wasn't so over cooked the sandwich would have been really good! I would definitely try it again in the future in hopes the chicken is cooked right! 

All in all, highly recommend trying this local gem!!
Simply the best! Great wines and great service. It's nice to have a safe place to go during these trying times.
Our first visit but definitely not the last!  The empanadas were fantastic!  Beef and chicken - both spicy. Served piping hot and freshly made. Owners are super friendly.

I love Naan Stop! The owner is amazing and goes the extra mile to be friendly and helpful with anything/everything. The food is great and made quickly; however, it's not made too quickly (which is comforting to know that it's made to order). I always get the vegetable biriyani and garlic naan, and they're always fresh, well-seasoned, and served in large portions! The mango chutney is definitely a must! 

This is a great place to go if you want delicious food and friendly service (especially from the owner--I cannot stress enough how much of a joy he is to be around and chat with). 

I will always talk this place up, because it's incredibly underrated. I always look forward to eating here :-)
Alex and Olivia are amazing! Ask for either one of them and you won't be disappointed... will definitely be coming back to visIt them

Pizza and atmosphere has always been great!!!!! It still has that classic feel of the vintage pizza parlor from back in the day!!!!  Lots of menu selections to choose from! Some of the best pizza and wings money can buy!!! You can't go wrong with Melissa and her friendly staff!
The fried pickles were the best! The burger was excellent and the Veijo IPA was amazing

Red Robin's has to be one of the best burger joint in the US. The way they make the burgers are juicy and flavorful. Went to three different locations and they all had good service. Been going to RR for the past eight years and haven't had a bad experience. The service and food was good. Would recommend this restaurant to anyone that loves burger.

Based off of my first visit, I give it 3.75 stars.

I'm actually surprised by a lot of the bad reviews.

To be honest, the food wasn't fantastic, but it was decent. No one in my party had a complaint about their hoagies, pizza, or their wings.

The portions were great.

The prices were great.

The taste was ok, nothing to write rave reviews about, but nothing to warrant 1 or 2 stars. 

I'm actually thinking about ordering from here for the Superbowl, although it is a bit out of the way for me.
I love it.  The foods were phenomenal. I would go back and eat there when I visit Missouri.

I love this place! We have been going here every year for Xmas, and many other days of the year. The shrimp dumplings are really excellent, but the sauce it comes with is on the salty side. Go for a very light dip. I've really liked everything I've had here, especially the mock duck, the tofu with chive blossoms, and the chow fun. I love the old school vibe inside, and that they give you a free pot of tea. What's chinese food without tea??

An excellent place for Xmas dinner, lazy day takeout, and every meal in between.

I hosted my boyfriends 50th birthday party in the River Room on Saturday, 8/17 and it was one of the best parties I've ever hosted! We did the Truckee River Buffet w/tri tip and open bar for one hour. The restaurant was able to special order linens for me to match my theme, which was great! We were able to arrive 2 hours before the party to start decorating and the staff was working hard to make sure the party their bar was ready before my guest arrived. The staff was amazing! Everything we asked for was provided with no complaints. Reto Gross and Kayla Scott were nothing but helpful and we emailed them multiple times before the party! You know when you host a party, you don't get to eat that much, but my guest said the food was AMAZING! 

Thank you Wild River Grille for a wonderful evening!

Top-notch! Unique food and cocktail menu that will blow you away!

We prefer to make it a date night but have taken the kids.

Definitely do the three-course meal so you don't miss anything.

Was excited to try this place but the hostess wasn't so pleasant we didn't do any reservation because we just arrived into the city and was just looking for a place to eat and this is the first place to pop up it was a party of 6 3 adults and 3 kids and she didn't even give us an option to wait she automatically told us  we can't seat you guys, you  can do reservations for another day if you guys would like and the restaurant wasn't even super busy not a great start to our two day trip here in philly

Run don't walk to this new establishment. Brought to you by our Seven Hills Turkish friends. Enjoy the best tasty delightful treats and baklava from Turkey cuisine. First day today and I will be back. Giving samples of the Turkish delights and they did not disappoint. Who doesn't love baklava? There are more varieties here than I have ever experienced, from almond to pistachio, chocolate and more. Stop, try some with Turkish coffee, what a great place to experience alone or with friends or family.

As a 35 year New Orleanian who lives Uptown, I don't especially enjoy drinks or dining in the French Quarter with its attitude, poor quality, & rude service.  Last Friday afternoon, Josh the bartender & Lawrence the oyster shucker changed that in an awesome way!!  Had met some friends & was walking past Coterie NOLA afterwards & decided to stop in for a drink & something to eat.  First, Josh is what I think of as an old school NOLA bartender--incredibly polite, can hear a pin drop 2 blocks away (LOL!), fast, a perfectionist as a mixologist, & both attentive & proactive.  Was kinda surprised to find out he wasn't from here originally because he's got that New Orleans "authenticity" about him--what a cool dude & amazing bartender!!  Lawrence turns oyster shucking into an art form, keeps a great sense of humor while making the customers feel welcome & is somehow able to present the oysters without a single shell fragment anywhere in them.  Josh & Lawrence worked like they'd been a team for 20 years--flawless cooperation & positive/friendly attitudes...they were like the restaurant version of a major league athletic team.  I chose to eat at the bar, ordered the jambalaya & some oysters, & immediately started asking myself WHY this was not my regular dining spot.  Truthfully, I was back again later in the weekend & was just as impressed.  So, for any other Locals, Coterie NOLA is a First Class old school New Orleans drinking & dining experience without that "touristy" feel!  And t

We ordered from Zuzus during coronavirus after a friend recommended It to us. They definitely had plenty of orders coming in and were swamped that night but continued to provide AMAZING customer service. We called to get an update and they were always honest. The food was delicious and for a local spot we will always continue to support them. They are wonderful

I love Yats!!! I had never been very adventurous when it comes to food but one of my coworkers ensured me that I'd like it. I eat with my eyes so if it doesn't look appealing then it's hard for me to have any desire. However, drunk chicken and mock shoe won over my heart! And that bread! Always need extra bread!! It shouldn't even be a question, just give me a baguette of their bread! Lol!
Service is great! The workers are all very friendly and helpful!!
Pizza was great! We got the jumbo size and it was huge!! Would recommend. A little overcrowded for my taste but overall great food.

So, you're in Clearwater and you get a hankering for Mexican food. The Spotted Donkey in the Hilton Clearwater Beach is a very good place for that! The Skinny Seniorita cocktails were a nice low-cal version of a margarita with just the right amount of pucker. The Tierra Y Mar Burro (Surf & Turf Burrito) was the real surprise here:  juicy and flavorful grilled filet mignon perfectly balance with moist and well seasoned seared shrimp. A great place to unwind without spending a fortune!

We were in town for a tournament and wanted some Florida seafood. The establishment was nice and we liked the outdoor seating.  The staff was friendly and food was fine, but nothing particularly special. We accidentally went during happy hour so it was crowded, but the prices and specials were great!

Yum. This place has been consistently delicious every time we've diner here while in Tucson. They have quite an extensive menu. We've had a variety of the offerings and have enjoyed everything. My favorite is the dessert case -- the confetti cake is THE BEST. Wish I could have it everyday. 
We were just there on Monday afternoon (around 2 PM) and it was so packed that people were waiting for tables. This seems like quite a popular place, probably for non-vegans too. It took a long time to get our food out this last time because it was so crowded, but we were patient and the food quality and taste were well worth the wait. The wait staff is also super nice. Great place! We look forward to going back. We love this vegan restaurant.
Cute modern restaurant with a solid menu. There is an outdoor patio which is super convenient for spring / summer. They also carry La Colombe coffee!

Its a Tuesday night and a bunch of us are out celebrating my work friends birthday.  Off to the old pub in bordentown for my second visit.  It was $5 margarita Tuesday so of course I got one.  Served in a mason jar with a nice sweet sour taste.  Appetizers calamari and pork nachos.  Both were tasty however the pork stood out being sweet and delicious.  I had the Mani Mani tacos with fries.  You get 3 of them with French fries.  Thier topping sauce was excellent and the fish was done right.  Prices are $15-$30 and all the food was good.  Dinner for 7 with no desert was $200.  All in all very nice experience and good food
Can't come to Tampa without stopping at Grimaldi's for a pie and some beer!  Pepperoni, bacon, garlic, and red onion, nuff said.
Awful service, do not reccomend.  Not buffalo sauce, not a cheesesteak, think hard before ordering from this awful place.

This spot was recommended by our air bnb host and was on the Mark! 
The security outside was super friendly, the atmosphere was cool and relaxing.  The aroma of all the food was amazing.  There flavors of the dinner for 2 (sorry I don't remember what it's called) was frickin crazy good!  Even if they didn't share the recipes 
Our waiter CJ was so nice and super friendly and informative.  Couldn't have asked for a better experience overall! 
Highly, highly recommend this spot to anyone visiting the area!

I had a pleasant experience at planet sub. For my first visit I had nice customer service provided to me by ceci. And let's not forget the food. There are plenty of menu options and what I chose was delicious. Very good alternative to the usual competitors.
Came here quickly for a drink. Ordered a beer (I believe the château de vélo) during happy hour. Loved the atmosphere. Chill spot. I'd be back!
EXCELLENT. BEST CHIPS AND SALSA. Chicken fajitas great as was Margaritas. Definitely recommend. Outdoor dining available.

I loved this place.  Chef Ferreri was fantastic there, the place was great, the staff was wonderful.  When I would visit Philly the past few years, I'd make a res at Res Ipsa before I made my hotel reservation.  This was such a memorable place and my meals were always superb.  

Finding out that Res Ipsa did not make it through the pandemic has me kind of blue right now.

Best wishes to everyone involved and I hope that you all land on your feet.  You all deserve the best.

Was looking forward to a delicious steak dinner on my birthday.  We started with drinks at the bar.  Besides being very overpriced, my steak was so heavily spiced, that I sent it back.  Didn't order another one because the seasoning kind of upset my stomach.  The mashed potatoes were hard and seemed reheated.  Didn't say anything at the time because I didn't want to make a scene.  Called the next day and spoke with manager named Eric.  He apologized for the incident, took my nsme, email, etc.  Never heard a word.  Last visit.

This experience so far has been pretty disappointing. I've been to other Rosewood property and always put them on par with Four Seasons. Unfortunately that is not the case for Rosewood Miramar. In all honestly I've been on property for 1 day of a 4 day stay so i will edit this if improvements are noted. Check is was out by the Valet due to Covid restrictions. We booked through AMEX fine hotels which offers a noon check in. (It is not guaranteed to be fair.) I was told at check in that it was not available but they would put a rush on my room. I was also told that no upgrade was available which is also a feature of the amex booking. Instead of being honest and telling me the room won't be ready until 4:00pm he said they would rush the room and would call me. We waited around until 4:00 pm arrived - still no call. We went to the front desk and complained and they said that we would need to wait another 1 hour. I asked for manager and miraculously a room became available. An upgraded room that i was told was not available 3 hours earlier. 

After we got to the room we were visited from someone on the hotel staff asking if the prior guest left a bag in the room. We looked around and found nothing and let him know. Then we were called and asked if we were confident there was no bag left in the room. It was borderline accusatory but we again confirmed that no bags besides our own were in the room. 

Dinner at Malibu the casual restaurant choice on property was pretty good. Food was
The burrito bowl was good but a little small in comparison with the other burrito bowl places. However, the prices were much higher. I don't think we'll be back. We get a much better deal at Qdoba

It's a fine establishment. These two ladies take good care of ya. I had the spicy shrimp and the wife had Kali Beef Ribs. Both meals were great. 
She just kept dropping little dishes of different foods in front of us. I have no idea what all of it was but I tried everyone one of them and they were a great distraction from my dish. All were unique and tasty. I think there was some Kimchi in there... maybe some tofu... all added to the experience.
All that to the background of the 80s lol.

I've been excited for this place to open and we weren't disappointed!  My daughter and I shared an appetizer and an entree and still had food leftover to bring home. The service was just right! Very friendly and everything came out perfectly timed and was really good! They serve beer and wine as well as saki cocktails. I tried one that was really good! We also shared the butter cake dessert that was served warm with mango purée and ice cream. It was huge so we couldn't finish it but so tasty! We will definitely go back!

First I want to mention that it was super confusing on how to get to the rooftop lounge. There are three restaurants connected to a hotel and little to no signage on hot to get to each of them. It is so confusing that when you get all the way up there you may feel like you've found access to a secret rooftop party, we both did.
.
To help you navigate it better, you are going to want to go inside of the hotel, take the elevator to level 10, get off, turn right, and then walk up one flight of stairs to get up to Roof-Top Restaurant! You can get to the indoor rooftop from the outside roof deck as well. 
.
Now to the fun stuff. The FOOD and the VIEW! The service was a bit slow, but the food, free birthday desert (gotta be really nice to your waiter for this one) and the view definitely made up for it. We recommend all of the food! I loved that the seared scallops were paired with Zucchini noodles and a delicious curry sauce! This was a great low carb option that kept us wanting more. The Big Dipper Platter was so perfect for sharing and had a variety of veggies, breads, and crackers to use for dipping in the Beat Hummus and Local Fish Spread. The Escargot or "Snails" took us right back to France. They were so perfectly cooked with garlicky, buttery goodness  Make sure to save room for some bread dipping after! The caprese salad was good, but nothing too special about it. The cheesecake was also good, I probably wouldn't pay for it but if it's your birthday I'd recommend just aski
My friend who is Asian and US army vet went here for dinner. Said the customers and staff stared at her like she was from another planet.

Listen we like IHOP since our kids love it and actually eat there but we probably won't go to this location again. We got sat down pretty quickly and it wasn't even busy. We ended up waiting 15-20 minutes and no one came to even at least order our drinks. A server even came up fill up our sugar and syrup and didn't even bother to ask if we had been helped. We were completely ignored by all the servers. My husband had to ask someone if someone was going to help us and all he got was an confused okay. After a few more minutes we just got up and left.

I have been coming to this establishment for years and sadly today their service was subpar.   I get it--it's busy but the staff is usually used to and still manages to give great service.   Today both the bar staff and the "hostess" were unpleasant and just plain rude.  There are are too many other places in the Quarter to grab a good meal and stiff drink minus the attitude and the wait.  So for today the two stars is strictly for the monsoon!

Phenomenal food and phenomenal service; I was absolutely blown away. We started with the eggplant parmigiana as an appetizer which was perfect. The flavor was great and it had just a bit of crispiness that really complimented the dish. For dinner, I had the Diver Scallops (one of the specials for the day). Let me start by saying these were the best scallops I've ever had. The sauce was some sort of oil-based, citrus/truffle blend, and they were topped with mushrooms and arugula. Spectacular. The service was speedy, and our waitress was incredibly polite. Highly recommend.

Do not order any steak as they will overcook it. I basically paid $20 for rice and veggies because my steak was so overdone- it was beyond inedible. The menu was lamented and filthy-they did not clean those in between guests. There was no social distancing going on as every table was filled. There was also no deep cleaning of the seats and table as we watched a party leave, the busboy did a quick wipe down and within 2 minutes another party was seated. The server was basically touching my yum yum sauce with no gloves and his mask was not covering his nose. This is in no way up to par with other Sakura restaurants.

I am really liking the vibe of this place. It's a place to hang out after work... a place to have a few drinks and snacks with your friends... or just a place to hang out and have a delicious meal. We did the latter.

We came hungry, so tried a few items on the menu. All were excellent! Service was also great and friendly. The restaurant was very modern and clean. 

Some key notes and must tries:
- Sashimi... we had 3 kinds of sashimi. Fresh and the octopus was delicious!
- Thursday nights they have chicken karaage for $0.95/piece. They are big pieces! I thought it would be like chicken wings, but they were boneless. The spicy mayo was really tasty!
- Wagyu beef... get it as sushi or heat it up on a hot stone. Whatever you choose, it's probably the best thing you will ever have. All you need is salt and pepper!
- Skewers... get them! We had pork belly and shrimp. So good!
- If you check in, you get free takoyaki or house salad. Get the house salad. I didn't find anything special about the takoyaki... I was hoping it would be crispier but was a bit mushy.
- Tako wasabi will surprise you... maybe surprised me too much as I couldn't finish it lol.

Overall, really liked this place and looking forward to trying other dishes. Will be back!

Food [4/5] - They have a wide variety of brunch options in terms of both food and breakfast cocktails. I went with a group of 6, and everyone seemed to enjoy their food.

Service [5/5] - The service was solid, and I was impressed with how quickly the staff helped us move the contents of our table inside when it randomly started pouring outside.

Ambiance [5/5] - If it's nice outside, I highly recommend sitting on the front patio. It's a terrific little place that feels like a natural oasis in the heart of Philly. The inside was very nice as well with a bit more of a rustic vibe.

Value [4/5] - The prices are on par with other Philly brunch places, and while their entrees aren't the most filling dishes in the world, they do satisfy.

This is my all time favorite chick fil a! Every time I go there they are more than nice, the food is amazing, and the restaurant is clean! Make sure to follow their Facebook page for awesome specials all the time like free 4 piece chicken minis on Tuesday mornings!

We came here for my birthday while we were in NOLA. Brittany was our server and made our night! She was so incredibly sweet and made our trip so great! Wish every waitress could be as great as she was! Food was delicious! Thank you!!

Sat at the bar with my hubby and enjoyed stellar cocktails and many of the appetizers. The best thing we ate was the grilled octopus which was charred to perfection and just so tender and delicious. The steak tartar was also good - the sauce tasted like a much fancier version of the secret sauce that comes on Big Macs, and bread it came with was perfect. We didn't understand the purpose of the giant sheets of iceberg lettuce but maybe it's meant for gluten free patrons? The garlic shrimp were also excellent and flavorful. The surf and turf Bao buns were yummy though we wished there was one of each for each of us. The house made buns were perfect. We will definitely be back. I want to eat everything on the menu!

Ummm.... the soup (beer cheese broccoli) could have been good if it had been more than lukewarm.  Ordered the fisherman's sandwich.  Not only was the filet less than 1/3 the standard sized bun, it was awful... not fresh...  downright disgusting.  Service was mediocre.  She kept trying to take our plates away (we should have let her) but we were still trying to find the edible food on our plate.  Needless to say we won't ever go back.
